## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Comillas, Spain. It starts at El Capricho de Gaudí, Barrio Sobrellano, Comillas, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Capricho de Gaudi.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The flexible entrance allows you to choose the day and the time slot you prefer to make your visit free. With your access ticket with free visit you can enjoy the entire enclosure, both exterior and interior.
>
> In our monumental site and museum you will find audiovisual content, graphic materials and exhibitions that will help you fully understand all the details of this unique building.
>
> El Capricho de Gaudí is a three-storey building and has a large garden so you can relax and enjoy the surroundings.
>
> Access is allowed to the outside and gardens with pets but these must be kept tied at all times. Access to the interior with pets is prohibited.
>
> You can take photographs throughout the venue as long as it does not affect the experience of other visitors. Minors must always be accompanied by an adult. Eating or drinking is not allowed inside the building.
>
> Gaudí's Capricho is one of the most important works of European modernism. This exotic and colorful palace is one of the first works of Antoni Gaudí and one of the only three that you can visit outside of Catalonia.
